products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

Dual Air Quality Sensors

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

Traps Hair & Allergens

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

Smart Control

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting

This build-your-own custom set option allows you to select the exact pieces that match your cooking style, whether you need a single fry pan or a complete pots and pans set — also commonly referred to as a hard anodized nonstick cookware set, nonstick pots and pans set, or the All-Clad Essentials HA nonstick collection.         All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick Piece Sizes and Options

        All-Clad Essentials Nonstick Coating and Hard Anodized Material
        Every piece in the All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized collection features a hard anodized aluminum body that is harder than stainless steel and resistant to warping. The 3-layer PTFE nonstick interior provides smooth food release and is PFOA-free. The exterior is also nonstick-coated for easy cleanup.
      

      
        What Stovetops Work With All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Cookware
        The All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware is compatible with gas, electric, ceramic, and halogen stovetops. It is not compatible with induction cooktops, as the hard anodized aluminum body is not magnetic. Each piece is also oven safe up to 500°F, making it versatile for stovetop-to-oven cooking.
      

      
        All-Clad Essentials Nonstick Cookware Care, Cleaning, and Warranty
        All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized pieces are dishwasher safe, though hand washing with warm soapy water and a soft sponge is recommended to preserve the nonstick coating over time. Metal utensils should be avoided to prevent scratching. The collection is backed by All-Clad's Limited Lifetime Warranty against defects in materials and craftsmanship.
      

    
  




  
    Cookware Performance & Features▼
  
  
    The All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware is engineered to deliver consistent, even cooking performance for everyday use. The thick hard anodized aluminum body conducts heat quickly and distributes it evenly across the entire cooking surface, eliminating hot spots that can scorch food. The 3-layer PTFE nonstick interior requires minimal oil or butter for cooking and releases food cleanly — including eggs, fish, and delicate sauces. About The Brand

When the first fully bonded pan rolled off its Pennsylvania assembly line more than 50 years ago, All-Clad forever changed the cookware industry. Founder John Ulam's background was not in cuisine but in metalworking—and through Ulam's brilliant cross-pollination of industries, a superior brand of cookware was born. Today, the same heritage and innovation that allowed Ulam to develop the first All-Clad pan is honored in every product that the brand's Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, team produces. Using modern ideas and time-honored techniques, every pot, pan, skillet, and saucier is crafted by hand—from bonding and forming to finishing and riveting—before making its way into your home.

      Yes. It features a removable interior straw and a convenient 
      flip-up bite valve for easy, spill-free sipping on the go.

      Its powder-coated stainless steel construction, double insulation, 
      and durable design provide long-lasting performance, stability, 
      and easy portability for any adventure.

products.description:
Rabbit Air products are in a class of air purification all their own. With highly sensitive odor and particle sensors, our advanced air purifiers detect the amount of pollutants in your environment and adjust their speed accordingly to assure the freshest air quality at all times.

 

(1) When it senses particles or odors in the air, the machine increases fan speed.

 

(2) The machine switches over to high speed until the air has been cleaned.

 

(3) Once the sensor detects a reduction in airborne pollutants, the machine will resume its original speed.

Our A3's light sensor automatically cuts back on light pollution by defaulting to a low-energy, dimmed sleep lighting when the room darkens. When daylight returns or light levels increase, the A3 resumes its normal mode.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

Dual Air Quality Sensors

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

*Compared to Vital 100S.

Wide U-Shaped Inlet

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

Traps Hair & Allergens

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

Smart Control

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

This build-your-own custom set option allows you to select the exact pieces that match your cooking style, whether you need a single fry pan or a complete pots and pans set — also commonly referred to as a hard anodized nonstick cookware set, nonstick pots and pans set, or the All-Clad Essentials HA nonstick collection.     What's In The Box▼
  
  
    

      
        All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick Piece Sizes and Options
        When you build your own All-Clad Essentials custom cookware set, you select from the available individual pieces: 8", 10", and 12" Fry Pans; 1.5 Qt., 2.5 Qt., and 4 Qt. Saucepans with Lids; a 3 Qt. Sauté Pan with Lid; and 6 Qt. or 8 Qt. Stockpots with Lids. Each piece is sold as part of your custom configuration, so your set contains exactly the pieces you choose — no extras you won't use.
      

      
        All-Clad Essentials Nonstick Coating and Hard Anodized Material
        Every piece in the All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized collection features a hard anodized aluminum body that is harder than stainless steel and resistant to warping. The 3-layer PTFE nonstick interior provides smooth food release and is PFOA-free. The exterior is also nonstick-coated for easy cleanup.
      

      
        What Stovetops Work With All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Cookware
        The All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware is compatible with gas, electric, ceramic, and halogen stovetops. It is not compatible with induction cooktops, as the hard anodized aluminum body is not magnetic. Each piece is also oven safe up to 500°F, making it versatile for stovetop-to-oven cooking.
      

      
        All-Clad Essentials Nonstick Cookware Care, Cleaning, and Warranty
        All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized pieces are dishwasher safe, though hand washing with warm soapy water and a soft sponge is recommended to preserve the nonstick coating over time. Metal utensils should be avoided to prevent scratching. The collection is backed by All-Clad's Limited Lifetime Warranty against defects in materials and craftsmanship.
      

    
  




  
    Cookware Performance & Features▼
  
  
    The All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware is engineered to deliver consistent, even cooking performance for everyday use. The thick hard anodized aluminum body conducts heat quickly and distributes it evenly across the entire cooking surface, eliminating hot spots that can scorch food. The 3-layer PTFE nonstick interior requires minimal oil or butter for cooking and releases food cleanly — including eggs, fish, and delicate sauces. Riveted stainless steel handles are securely attached and stay cool on the stovetop during normal use, providing a comfortable, stable grip. Where included, stainless steel lids fit securely to seal in moisture and heat during cooking.

    Stovetop & Oven Compatibility▼
  
  
    The All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware is compatible with most common residential stovetops and is oven safe to 500°F, making it suitable for a wide range of cooking techniques from stovetop searing to finishing dishes in the oven. Because the body is made from hard anodized aluminum — a non-magnetic material — this collection is not compatible with induction cooktops. Broiler use is not recommended, as extreme direct heat can degrade the nonstick coating over time.

Halogen Stovetop: Compatible

    Note: If you require induction compatibility, consider the All-Clad D3 or D5 stainless steel collections, which feature a magnetic stainless steel exterior.
  




  
    Frequently Asked Questions▼
  
  

    
      Is the All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware induction compatible?
      No. The All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware is not compatible with induction cooktops. The hard anodized aluminum body is not magnetic, which is required for induction cooking. This collection works on gas, electric, ceramic, and halogen stovetops. If you need induction-compatible All-Clad cookware, the D3 Stainless, D5 Stainless, or Copper Core collections are induction-ready alternatives.
    

    
      What pieces are available when I build my own All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized custom cookware set?
      When building a custom All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick set, you can select from a range of individual pieces including 8", 10", and 12" fry pans; 1.5 Qt., 2.5 Qt., and 4 Qt. saucepans with lids; a 3 Qt. sauté pan with lid; and 6 Qt. or 8 Qt. stockpots with lids. This lets you create a set tailored to your cooking needs rather than buying a fixed configuration.
    

    
      Is the All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware dishwasher safe?
      Yes, the All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick cookware is technically dishwasher safe. However, All-Clad and most cookware experts recommend hand washing with warm soapy water and a soft cloth or sponge to best preserve the 3-layer PTFE nonstick coating and extend the life of the cookware. Repeated dishwasher cycles can gradually break down nonstick surfaces over time.
    

    
      How is the All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized different from the All-Clad HA1 or D3 collections?
      The All-Clad Essentials Hard Anodized Nonstick is All-Clad's entry-level hard anodized nonstick line, designed for everyday home cooking at a more accessible price. The All-Clad HA1 (Hard Anodized 1) is a similar hard anodized nonstick collection that shares the same non-induction aluminum construction but may differ in handle design and coating weight. The D3 and D5 collections are fully clad stainless steel cookware — not nonstick — and are induction compatible, making them a distinct choice suited for high-heat searing and browning rather than nonstick cooking tasks.

  The All-Clad HA1 Hard Anodized Nonstick Cookware — also referred to as the HA1 nonstick pots and pans set or HA1 cookware collection — is a professional-grade line designed for everyday home cooking where easy food release and durability are the priority. This build-your-own custom set option allows you to select the exact pieces you use most, from skillets and saucepans to sauté pans and stockpots, so your kitchen is equipped precisely to your needs. Each piece is constructed from hard anodized aluminum with a 3-layer PTFE nonstick interior and a stainless steel base for induction compatibility. This collection is ideal for home cooks who want All-Clad performance and versatility without committing to a fixed piece count.




  What's In The Box▼
  
    

      
        All-Clad HA1 Pieces Available to Select
        Because this is a custom build set, you choose your own combination from the full All-Clad HA1 lineup. Available pieces typically include 8-inch and 10-inch skillets, 1.5-quart and 3-quart saucepans with lids, a 3-quart sauté pan with lid, and a 6-quart stockpot with lid. Select the pieces that match how you cook every day.
      

      
        All-Clad HA1 Nonstick Coating and Material Specs
        Each All-Clad HA1 piece features a hard anodized aluminum body that is twice as hard as stainless steel, paired with a 3-layer PTFE nonstick interior. The hard anodized exterior is scratch-resistant and provides even heat absorption across the entire cooking surface.
      

      
        All-Clad HA1 Stovetop Compatibility and Versatility
        All-Clad HA1 cookware is compatible with all stovetop types, including induction, gas, electric, ceramic, and halogen burners. The stainless steel magnetic base enables full induction compatibility, making this set suitable for virtually any kitchen setup.
      

      
        All-Clad HA1 Care Instructions and Warranty Coverage
        All-Clad HA1 cookware is dishwasher safe, though handwashing is recommended to preserve the nonstick coating long-term. Use low to medium heat and avoid metal utensils to extend the life of the nonstick surface. All pieces are backed by All-Clad's limited lifetime warranty.
      

    
  




  Cookware Performance & Features▼
  
    The All-Clad HA1 hard anodized nonstick cookware is engineered to deliver consistent, reliable results whether you are searing, sautéing, simmering, or boiling. Its construction combines a high-gauge hard anodized aluminum body with a stainless steel induction base, resulting in fast, even heat distribution from edge to edge with no hot spots. The 3-layer PTFE nonstick coating releases food effortlessly with minimal oil, making cleanup straightforward after every use. Ergonomic stainless steel handles are secured with stainless rivets for a secure, comfortable grip that stays cool on the stovetop. Tempered glass lids fit snugly to seal in moisture and are oven safe up to 350°F, while the cookware body handles up to 500°F — suitable for stovetop-to-oven techniques.
    
      
Nonstick coating: 3-layer PTFE interior for easy food release and low-oil cooking

  Stovetop & Oven Compatibility▼
  
    All-Clad HA1 hard anodized nonstick cookware is designed for universal stovetop compatibility. The stainless steel magnetic base makes every piece in the HA1 lineup fully compatible with induction cooktops, and all pieces perform equally well on gas, electric coil, smooth-top electric, ceramic, and halogen burners. The cookware body is oven safe up to 500°F, supporting a wide range of cooking techniques from stovetop browning to oven finishing. Glass lids included with select pieces are oven safe to 350°F.

  Frequently Asked Questions▼
  

    
      Is All-Clad HA1 induction compatible?
      Yes. All-Clad HA1 hard anodized nonstick cookware includes a stainless steel magnetic base bonded to the bottom of every piece, making it fully compatible with induction cooktops as well as all other stovetop types including gas, electric, ceramic, and halogen.
    

    
      What pieces can I include in an All-Clad HA1 custom set?
      The All-Clad HA1 build-your-own custom set lets you choose from the full HA1 lineup, which typically includes 8-inch and 10-inch nonstick skillets, 1.5-quart and 3-quart saucepans with lids, a 3-quart sauté pan with lid, and a 6-quart stockpot with lid. Select only the pieces you use most frequently.
    

    
      Is All-Clad HA1 hard anodized nonstick cookware dishwasher safe?
      All-Clad HA1 is labeled dishwasher safe, but All-Clad recommends handwashing to preserve the 3-layer PTFE nonstick coating and extend the lifespan of the cookware. Washing by hand with warm soapy water and a soft cloth is the best practice for long-term nonstick performance.
    

    
      How does the All-Clad HA1 differ from the All-Clad D3 or D5?
      The All-Clad HA1 features a hard anodized aluminum construction with a PTFE nonstick interior, making it the preferred choice for low-fat cooking and easy cleanup. The D3 and D5 lines are fully clad stainless steel cookware without a nonstick coating, designed for high-heat searing and metal utensil use. The HA1 is the right choice when nonstick release is the priority; the D3 or D5 are better suited for tasks that require very high heat or browning fond.

The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

products.description:
Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

Dual Air Quality Sensors

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

*Compared to Vital 100S.

Wide U-Shaped Inlet

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

Traps Hair & Allergens

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

Smart Control

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.
products.name: Levoit Vital® Pet Air Purifier for Pets

	*  Main Filter: Removes 99.97% of ultrafine particles down to 0.3 μm
	*  High-Density Activated Carbon Filter: Effectively reduces gases and odors

Protection for All Seasons & Situations

Ideal for homes with babies, pets, smokers, allergy sufferers, and frequent cooks. Effectively filters wildfire smoke, seasonal pollen, vehicle exhaust, and humidity-triggered odors—reliable protection year-round.

Created Exclusively for LV-H132 Series

Levoit's Filter Life Indicator and built-in algorithm work only with authentic filters. Using non-genuine filters may result in delayed replacement alerts, reduced air quality, and potential damage to the purifier motor.

Why Choose AHAM VERIFIDE Filters?

AHAM (Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers) is an ANSI-accredited organization that sets strict standards for appliance performance. Filters bearing the AHAM VERIFIDE seal have been independently tested for filtration performance, safety, and compatibility—so you can trust every breath you take.

Properly Sealed for Freshness

Each filter is sealed to protect its service life. Remember to remove the plastic packaging before placing the filter into your air purifier.

The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

Dual Air Quality Sensors

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

*Compared to Vital 100S.

Wide U-Shaped Inlet

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

Traps Hair & Allergens

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

Smart Control

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

products.description:
Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

Dual Air Quality Sensors

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

*Compared to Vital 100S.

Wide U-Shaped Inlet

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

Traps Hair & Allergens

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

Smart Control

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

About The Brand

When the first fully bonded pan rolled off its Pennsylvania assembly line more than 50 years ago, All-Clad forever changed the cookware industry. Founder John Ulam's background was not in cuisine but in metalworking—and through Ulam's brilliant cross-pollination of industries, a superior brand of cookware was born. Today, the same heritage and innovation that allowed Ulam to develop the first All-Clad pan is honored in every product that the brand's Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, team produces. Using modern ideas and time-honored techniques, every pot, pan, skillet, and saucier is crafted by hand—from bonding and forming to finishing and riveting—before making its way into your home.

About The Brand

When the first fully bonded pan rolled off its Pennsylvania assembly line more than 50 years ago, All-Clad forever changed the cookware industry. Founder John Ulam's background was not in cuisine but in metalworking—and through Ulam's brilliant cross-pollination of industries, a superior brand of cookware was born. Today, the same heritage and innovation that allowed Ulam to develop the first All-Clad pan is honored in every product that the brand's Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, team produces. Using modern ideas and time-honored techniques, every pot, pan, skillet, and saucier is crafted by hand—from bonding and forming to finishing and riveting—before making its way into your home.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

products.description:
Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

 Dual Air Quality Sensors 

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

 Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them 

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

 

*Compared to Vital 100S.

 Wide U-Shaped Inlet 

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

 

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

 Traps Hair & Allergens 

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

 Smart Control 

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

 Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting 

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

About The Brand

When the first fully bonded pan rolled off its Pennsylvania assembly line more than 50 years ago, All-Clad forever changed the cookware industry. Founder John Ulam's background was not in cuisine but in metalworking—and through Ulam's brilliant cross-pollination of industries, a superior brand of cookware was born. Today, the same heritage and innovation that allowed Ulam to develop the first All-Clad pan is honored in every product that the brand's Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, team produces. Using modern ideas and time-honored techniques, every pot, pan, skillet, and saucier is crafted by hand—from bonding and forming to finishing and riveting—before making its way into your home.

Care Instructions: To ensure optimal performance, season the pan before first use by coating it lightly with oil and heating gently. Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

 Dual Air Quality Sensors 

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

 Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them 

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

 

*Compared to Vital 100S.

 Wide U-Shaped Inlet 

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

 

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

 Traps Hair & Allergens 

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

 Smart Control 

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

 Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting 

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

About The Brand

When the first fully bonded pan rolled off its Pennsylvania assembly line more than 50 years ago, All-Clad forever changed the cookware industry. Founder John Ulam's background was not in cuisine but in metalworking—and through Ulam's brilliant cross-pollination of industries, a superior brand of cookware was born. Today, the same heritage and innovation that allowed Ulam to develop the first All-Clad pan is honored in every product that the brand's Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, team produces. Using modern ideas and time-honored techniques, every pot, pan, skillet, and saucier is crafted by hand—from bonding and forming to finishing and riveting—before making its way into your home.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.

Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms.  Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

When the first fully bonded pan rolled off its Pennsylvania assembly line more than 50 years ago, All-Clad forever changed the cookware industry. Founder John Ulam's background was not in cuisine but in metalworking—and through Ulam's brilliant cross-pollination of industries, a superior brand of cookware was born. Today, the same heritage and innovation that allowed Ulam to develop the first All-Clad pan is honored in every product that the brand's Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, team produces. Using modern ideas and time-honored techniques, every pot, pan, skillet, and saucier is crafted by hand—from bonding and forming to finishing and riveting—before making its way into your home.

When the first fully bonded pan rolled off its Pennsylvania assembly line more than 50 years ago, All-Clad forever changed the cookware industry. Founder John Ulam's background was not in cuisine but in metalworking—and through Ulam's brilliant cross-pollination of industries, a superior brand of cookware was born. Today, the same heritage and innovation that allowed Ulam to develop the first All-Clad pan is honored in every product that the brand's Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, team produces. Using modern ideas and time-honored techniques, every pot, pan, skillet, and saucier is crafted by hand—from bonding and forming to finishing and riveting—before making its way into your home.

The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. 	*  Main Filter: Removes 99.97% of ultrafine particles down to 0.3 μm
	*  High-Density Activated Carbon Filter: Effectively reduces gases and odors

Protection for All Seasons & Situations

Ideal for homes with babies, pets, smokers, allergy sufferers, and frequent cooks. Effectively filters wildfire smoke, seasonal pollen, vehicle exhaust, and humidity-triggered odors—reliable protection year-round.

Created Exclusively for LV-H132 Series

Levoit's Filter Life Indicator and built-in algorithm work only with authentic filters. Using non-genuine filters may result in delayed replacement alerts, reduced air quality, and potential damage to the purifier motor.

Why Choose AHAM VERIFIDE Filters?

AHAM (Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers) is an ANSI-accredited organization that sets strict standards for appliance performance. Filters bearing the AHAM VERIFIDE seal have been independently tested for filtration performance, safety, and compatibility—so you can trust every breath you take.

Properly Sealed for Freshness

Each filter is sealed to protect its service life. Remember to remove the plastic packaging before placing the filter into your air purifier.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.
