Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

 Dual Air Quality Sensors 

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

 Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them 

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

 

*Compared to Vital 100S.

 Wide U-Shaped Inlet 

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

 

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

 Traps Hair & Allergens 

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

 Smart Control 

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

 Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting 

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

products.description:
Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

Dual Air Quality Sensors

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

*Compared to Vital 100S.

Wide U-Shaped Inlet

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

 Dual Air Quality Sensors 

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

 Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them 

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

 Wide U-Shaped Inlet 

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

 

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

 Traps Hair & Allergens 

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

 Smart Control 

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

 Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting 

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

products.description:
The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

Its sleek and simple design blends seamlessly with your home’s aesthetic, measuring 18.5 inches tall and weighing 15.8 pounds, so you can easily hide it or move it from room to room.  The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.

Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

products.description:
Life with pets is joyful, but the air doesn't have to tell that story. The Levoit Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier is engineered from the ground up for pet households — intelligently sensing, filtering, and freshening your air so you can focus on the moments that matter.

 Dual Air Quality Sensors 

Two built-in sensors detect both odor (VOCs) and PM2.5 particles — targeting the invisible culprits like pet dander and dust that standard purifiers miss. The fan speed adjusts automatically, so your air is always at its freshest without you lifting a finger.

 Adsorbs Odors, Not Just Masks Them 

Most purifiers simply cover up pet smells. Vital Pet Pro goes further — its advanced Activated Carbon Filter targets the acidic compounds at the root of pet odors, eliminating them 3.34x faster* for real, lasting freshness you can actually smell the difference.

 

*Compared to Vital 100S.

 Wide U-Shaped Inlet 

The 2-cm-wide U-shaped inlet is designed to capture floating pet hair before it clogs the filter. In testing, it removes up to 99% of floating pet hair within 1.4 ft*, and handles even stubborn clumps of fur for a visibly cleaner home.

 

*Tested with 1–2 mg of cat fur.

 Traps Hair & Allergens 

The washable pre-filter catches pet hair and large debris, while the main filter tackles dander and allergens. In Sleep Mode, HEPA-grade filtration removes 99.97% of 0.3 μm fine particles — quietly working through the night so you wake up to cleaner air.

 Smart Control 

Manage your air quality from anywhere with the VeSync app, or use voice control for hands-free convenience. Smart scheduling keeps your purifier running on your terms. And with Pet Plus mode, you can customize settings for when you walk your pet, leave home, or return — so Vital Pet Pro fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

 Easy Maintenance & Long Lasting 

A filter indicator light takes the guesswork out of maintenance, and the display lock keeps your settings safe. The included chew-resistant cable is built for real life with pets — durable, practical, and ready for whatever your furry friend throws at it.

The Energy Star-rated Levoit LV-RH131S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier quietly delivers clean air in rooms up to 360 square feet.

The flat top includes touch controls and an LCD display for easy access, showing the current mode, a check filter indicator, fan speed, and more at a glance. Its combination of three filters, including a True HEPA layer, ensures reliable air quality for you and your family.


Key Features and Benefits of the Levoit Smart True HEPA Air Purifier




Remote App Access: By downloading the VeSync app, you can turn your phone into a remote control and adjust the settings from anywhere at any time. It is available in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and can connect to Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant for voice control.


Air Quality indicator: This light indicates the current air quality level thanks to an automatic dust sensor inside the purifier, which may take up to one minute to detect the air quality for an accurate reading. The light is red for bad, yellow for moderate, green for good, or blue for very good.


Fan Speeds and Auto Mode: Using the inner dust sensor, the Auto Mode automatically adjusts the fan speed based on the current air quality. Otherwise, you can select low, medium, or high fan speeds.


Sleep Mode: The sleek design of this quiet air purifier makes it perfect for bedrooms, and the sleep mode keeps it operating quietly to ensure uninterrupted sleep at a noise level as low as 27 dB.


Programmable Timer: Press the button on the control panel to program a run time between one and 12 hours, automatically turning off afterward.



Filtration Levels




Combination Prefilter and True HEPA Filter: The prefilter layer traps large airborne particles such as hair, pet fur, lint, and fibers while protecting the primary filter and extending its life. The True HEPA filter captures at least 99.97 percent of smaller allergens and particles 0.3 microns in size, like bacteria, mold spores, pet dander, fine dust, smoke, and pollen.


High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter: Engineered with activated carbon, this filter removes household odors, pet odors, smoke, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), cooking smells, and fumes for cleaner-smelling air. The carbon also filters compounds like benzene, ammonia, formaldehyde, and hydrogen sulfide. Its honeycomb structure gives a great surface area for particles to stick to.

products.description:
Immerse yourself in the heritage of the CRISTEL® brand with our new 1826® collection.
This 18/10 stainless steel frying pan with a brushed finish reflects a rich history, which was a turning point in the world of cookware.
1826® saw the creation of the world’s first stamped saucepan, manufactured at our factory in Fesches-le-Châtel, France. Nearly two centuries later, this new collection, symbolically named 1826®, takes its inspiration from the past while embodying the modernity, innovation, and passion that drive CRISTEL® every day. 
Our 1826® frying pan stands out thanks to its tapered base, paying tribute to the two-hundred-year-old saucepan that gave rise to this collection. It is available in 5 sizes/ diameters: 8“ / 9.50“ / 10“ / 11“ / 12“. 
Its induction-compatible, heat-diffusing base in three superimposed layers (induction stainless steel - aluminum - 18/10 stainless steel) guarantees even heat distribution across its entire surface, so you can sear a piece of meat or sauté a medley of vegetables effortlessly, without the need to add fat.
For cooking fish, potatoes, or eggs, opt for the 1826® Non-stick Frying Pan.
In addition to its performance, this pan is designed for compact storage, optimizing space in your kitchen.
Its heat-resistant, ergonomic, and firmly riveted handle does not conduct heat, providing a pleasant grip with no risk of burns, assuring enhanced safety in the kitchen.
For optimized heat distribution, enhance your stainless steel cookware with our Glass Lid from the 1826® collection.
Explore our wide range of CRISTEL® Frying Pans available on our website, for even more choice.

products.description:
The stainless steel frying pan is designed with a hybrid ceramic non stick coating to help home cooks prepare everyday meals with smoother food release and easier cleanup. This frying pan set provides flexible cooking options for everything from individual portions to larger family dishes. The PFOA-free non stick surface helps create a convenient cooking experience for eggs, vegetables, meats, and other daily recipes.

Built with a stainless steel body, honeycomb etched surface, and 3-ply construction with an aluminum core, this frying pan delivers durable performance with efficient heat distribution. The stainless steel structure provides strength, while the hybrid ceramic coating adds non stick convenience without changing the cookware’s main material. Compatible with gas, electric, ceramic, and induction cooktops, the pan is also oven safe up to 500°F for versatile kitchen use.

Whether preparing breakfast in a small apartment or cooking larger meals for the family, this stainless steel frying pan supports a wide range of everyday recipes. The 8 inch size works well for smaller servings and quick cooking tasks, while the 12 inch pan offers more space for multi-ingredient meals. With its durable construction and practical design, it is a useful cookware upgrade or a thoughtful gift for home cooks.

products.description:
Product Description:
Experience next-generation cookware performance with this Hybrid Nonstick Frying Pan, engineered with a circle-pattern hybrid surface that combines the best of stainless steel searing and nonstick convenience. Built with 2.5 mm tri-ply stainless steel construction and finished with a mirror-polished exterior, this pan offers fast, even heating and modern kitchen elegance.
Unlike traditional nonstick pans, the innovative cooking surface features a raised stainless steel circle pattern over a nonstick coating, giving you the ability to sear, sauté, and release food easily—all without the need for excess oils or sprays.
Features:


Diameter: 28 cm (11”)


Depth: 5.5 cm (2.16”)


Capacity: 3 L (3.17 qt)


Construction: Tri-ply stainless steel (2.5 mm thick)


Pattern: Circular ridges

Exterior: Mirror-polished finish for a sleek, professional look


Cooking Surface: Hybrid design with raised stainless steel circle pattern + nonstick coating


Handle: Ergonomic stainless steel handle, riveted for strength


Lid: Tempered glass lid included – lets you monitor cooking without lifting


Heat Tolerance:


Pan oven-safe up to 500°F (260°C)


Tempered glass lid oven-safe up to 400°F (204°C)


Compatibility:


Works on all stovetops, including induction, gas, electric, and ceramic


Dishwasher safe for easy cleanup (hand washing recommended for longevity)


Performance Benefits:


Hybrid surface allows for perfect searing and easy food release


Stainless steel base ensures even heat distribution with no hot spots


Durable nonstick coating resists scratching and flaking


Ideal for eggs, fish, meat, vegetables, and more


Whether you're a home chef or a culinary enthusiast, this pan brings together the sear of stainless steel with nonstick performance—without compromise.



Attribute
Description




Construction

Laser‑etched circular ridges over nonstick valleys—stainless-steel peaks form a hybrid surface that combines the benefits of stainless steel and nonstick.


Nonstick Coating

Durable hybrid nonstick coating protected by raised steel ridges—designed for long-lasting performance and resistance to scratching.


Heat Distribution

Aluminum core sandwiched between stainless steel layers ensures fast, even heat distribution and excellent heat retention.


Durability
Steel ridges shield the nonstick coating, preventing damage and wear during everyday cooking.


Searing Performance
Circular ridges allow food to sear and brown effectively while excess moisture drains into lower valleys, enhancing texture and flavor.


Ease of Cleaning
Designed for easy cleaning—nonstick valleys release food with minimal residue, and circular pattern prevents buildup.


Oven Safety

Oven safe up to 260 °C (500 °F); allows seamless transfer from stovetop to oven. Glass lid may have lower heat tolerance.


Compatibility with Cooktops

Induction compatible—magnetic stainless-steel base also works on gas, electric, ceramic, and halogen cooktops.


Chemical Safety

PFOA-free hybrid coating designed to reduce chemical exposure while maintaining performance at high temperatures.


Unique Advantage
Hybrid surface delivers the ease of nonstick, the durability of stainless steel, and enhanced cooking control with its circular ridge design.
